craft_notes: Sthāyin: Longing to see and stay; vow. Sthāyin: longing to see and stay (rati-darśana). Device: comma→dash (looking held), dash→comma (lovely softens onto harbouring). Rejected: 'plumb' for look — killed: sense verb is seeing (darśana); kept look. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: O let us look on the Profound, ringed with higher light —
dark wiped away, lovely, and harbour in your hollow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām
